draft.subject: Alert signal: Diarrhoea or vomiting
draft.body:
A alert signal for diarrhoea or vomiting covers Thaga Park, Leeba View, Nonyana Flats.

52 cases were reported on 23 cards in 3 days, against usually about 6.93, from 4 places of care.

1 card describes patients as sicker than usual; 0 cards describe patients not improving as usual.

Please review Works A first as a possible source, alongside the other evidence. This does not confirm a cause.

footer: Raised by Lemoha from clinicians' reports. Lemoha points to where to look; it does not confirm a cause. A person decided to send this. Notifiable medical conditions are still notified through the NMC system.
